title: Multivariate Outlier Screening via Mahalanobis D2 and Cook's Influence Sensitivity
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for OUTLIERS.
research_question: Are multivariate outliers present in cognitive performance indices, and do they exert disproportionate influence on parameter estimates?

must_do.description: Compute Mahalanobis distance D2 for all cases against chi2 distribution at p < .001.
Evaluate Cook's distance to determine parameter leverage.
Conduct sensitivity analysis comparing models with and without influential cases.

must_not_do.description: Silently delete extreme cases without reporting D2, df, and p-values.
Rely solely on univariate inspection for multivariate models.

required_evidence.description: Mahalanobis D2 diagnostic table with critical cutoff.
